plan.title: Withdraw offered on live RFQ with two bids

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event on its summary page.
Open the RFQ Participants list so a second bid can be entered for another invited vendor.
Add the second bid on behalf of another invited vendor to reproduce the two-bid setup.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted.
Confirm the live RFQ now shows responses from both vendors, including the surrogate bid.
Assert that Withdraw is present and enabled in the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Click Withdraw and leave its confirmation window open without confirming the withdrawal.
Confirm that selecting Withdraw opens the withdrawal window.
Cancel the withdrawal so the event remains unchanged.
Confirm the withdrawal window closed after cancellation.
